title: 第十七章 先为民除害然后再顺手发财第十八章 雾山坊市大采购啥厉害买啥
slug: 看守废丹房三年我偷偷成仙了
lines: “炼气十二层修为……啥意思，这是要摘桃子？还是要杀人夺宝？”
秦凡眉头微皱，这个节骨眼上追过来，这老道士能有什么好事？
“道友请留步。”
望见秦凡转头，吕文秋远远地喊了一声。
这句话，怎地感觉有些不太吉利？
“算了，还是先看看这老道士究竟要做什么吧。”
狗王的逃跑方向已被秦凡掌握，倒也不怕跟丢了，于是他果断在一处林间空地落下。
早些把事解决了，也省的在他摘取灵药的时候出来扫兴。
吕文秋的御风之术倒也不慢，没过多久，便飘然掠到了秦凡的近前。
“道友追来不知所为何事？”
秦凡率先开口，淡淡询问。
“在下吕文秋，乃这太平县白云观的观主。”
“敢问道友如何称呼？”
吕文秋拂尘轻甩，面带笑容，一派道家高人模样。
“在下王大彪，散修一个。”秦凡拱手道。
王……王大彪？
吕文秋微微错愕，修仙之人，竟还有这般朴素的名字？
“吕道友，你貌似还没回答我的话呢？”秦凡注视着吕文秋问道。
吕文秋收回思绪，轻笑道：“在下过来，只是好心提醒道友一句，再往前几十里，有一头刚刚筑基的火蟒豹，道友追杀可以，但莫要太过深入，以免遇到危险。”
刚刚筑基的火蟒豹？嚯，这特么不是来着了吗？秦凡一听吕文秋的话，眼睛登时便亮了起来。
吕文秋不免有些错愕，这咋地，好像更兴奋了吗？难道是我的错觉？
仔细打量了秦凡一下，唔，这会儿倒是没有先前的感觉了，那这么一看，刚才应该便是错觉无疑了。
吕文秋收回目光，道：“王道友，你此来太平县，可有别的什么事？若有需要帮忙的，或许在下能帮上一些。”
帮忙？秦凡心下微动，这吕文秋既是地头蛇，想来应该知晓附近哪有大型的修仙者坊市。
本打算到胥国京城再买神通和灵剑，可这一路飞过来，秦凡觉得手里没点趁手家伙，安全感实在不是很足。
别看这一路没啥大危险，但妖兽真是不少见，这要是哪天撞见一头筑基中期的，那不就完犊子了吗？
于是秦凡略微思索，便对吕文秋道：“在下还真有件事可能需要道友帮忙。”
“道友直说便是。”吕文秋轻笑着道。
秦凡道：“吕道友可知这附近哪里有大型的修仙坊市？”
“自然知晓。”
吕文秋笑了笑，道：“在太平县东面五百里便是京兆府梅县，在梅县雾山有一座大型坊市，此坊市规模仅次京城坊市，背后是京兆府五大修仙家族所掌控。”
“这五大修仙家族，每一家都有元婴大能坐镇，也因此，这雾山坊市已存在上百年而不倒。”
“雾山……”将位置记下，秦凡决定今晚之后便去雾山走一趟。
提升实力，已是迫在眉睫之事，他可不想遇到危险一点底牌没有，只能一顿火球术伺候。
“道友若是想去，在下可随时领道友前往。”吕文秋主动提议。
“不敢劳烦道友，在下自行前去便是。”秦凡摇头婉拒。
所谓防人之心不可无，出门在外，还是小心谨慎为好。
吕文秋点了点头，倒也没有不悦，旋即和秦凡告辞一声，便施展御风之术，往太平县城赶回。
“这老家伙走的倒是痛快，难道，他真的是个好人？”望着吕文秋逐渐远去的背影，秦凡内心不由得暗自想到。
出于谨慎，秦凡以神识探查了一下，一直追踪吕文秋到了极限的一里之外，也没发现异常。
content_en:
"The twelfth level of Qi refining...what do you mean, are you trying to pick peaches? Or are you trying to kill people and seize treasures?"
Qin Fan frowned slightly, chasing after him at this juncture, what good could this old Taoist priest do?
"Fellow Taoist, please stay."
Seeing Qin Fan turn his head, Lu Wenqiu shouted from a distance.
"..."
Why does this sentence feel a little unlucky?
"Forget it, let's see what this old Taoist priest is going to do first."
The direction of the dog king's escape was already known by Qin Fan, so he was not afraid of losing him, so he decisively landed in a clearing in the forest.
If we settle the matter earlier, we won't have to come out to spoil the fun when he is picking the elixir.
Lu Wenqiu's wind control skills were not slow at all. It didn't take long before he floated in front of Qin Fan.
"Fellow Taoist is chasing me and I don't know why?"
Qin Fan was the first to speak and asked lightly.
"I am Lu Wenqiu, the master of Baiyun Temple in Taiping County."
"How would you like to call my friend?"
Lu Wenqiu flicked his fly whisk, with a smile on his face, looking like a Taoist master.
"I'm Wang Dabiao, a casual cultivator." Qin Fan cupped his hands and said.
Wang...Wang Dabiao?
Lu Wenqiu was slightly surprised. A person who cultivates immortality actually has such a simple name?
"Fellow Daoist Lu, it seems you haven't answered my question yet?" Qin Fan looked at Lu Wenqiu and asked.
Lu Wenqiu retracted his thoughts and chuckled: "I'm here, I just kindly remind you, a few dozen miles ahead, there is a fire python leopard that has just established its foundation. You can chase it, but don't go too deep to avoid danger."
The fire python leopard that just established its foundation? Oops, isn’t this coming? Qin Fan's eyes immediately lit up when he heard Lu Wenqiu's words.
Lu Wenqiu couldn't help but be a little surprised. Does this seem to be more exciting? Is it my misunderstanding?
After looking at Qin Fan carefully, he felt that he didn't feel the same as before. From this look, it must have been an illusion.
Lu Wenqiu withdrew his gaze and said, "Fellow Daoist Wang, do you have anything else to do when you come to Taiping County? If you need help, maybe I can help."
Help? Qin Fan's heart moved slightly. Since Lu Wenqiu was a local snake, he probably knew that there was no large-scale immortal cultivator market nearby.
He originally planned to go to the capital of Xu Kingdom to buy magical powers and spiritual swords, but after flying all the way here, Qin Fan felt that he didn't have anyone to take advantage of, and he didn't feel very secure.
Although there is no major danger along the way, monsters are not uncommon. If one day we bump into one in the middle stage of foundation building, wouldn't it be the end of the world?
So Qin Fan thought for a moment and said to Lu Wenqiu: "I really have something that I may need help from my fellow Taoist."
"Fellow Taoist, just say so." Lu Wenqiu said with a chuckle.
Qin Fan said: "Do you know, Fellow Daoist Lu, where there is a large Xiuxianfang City nearby?"
"Nature knows."
Lu Wenqiu smiled and said: "Five hundred miles east of Taiping County is Jingzhao Prefecture's Meixian County. There is a large-scale city in Wushan in Meixian County. The size of this city is second only to the Jingcheng City. Behind it is the five major immortal cultivating families in Jingzhao Prefecture."
"Each of these five major cultivating families has a powerful Nascent Soul in charge. Therefore, this Wushanfang City has existed for hundreds of years without falling."
"Wushan..." After writing down the location, Qin Fan decided to take a trip to Wushan after tonight.
Improving his strength was an urgent matter. He didn't want to encounter danger and had no trump card, so he could only wait for him with a fireball.
"If fellow Taoist want to go, I can take you there at any time." Lu Wenqiu offered.
"I don't dare bother my fellow Taoist, I'll just go on my own." Qin Fan shook his head and declined.
As the saying goes, it is essential to be on guard against others. It is better to be cautious when going out.
Lu Wenqiu nodded, not displeased, and immediately said goodbye to Qin Fan, then used his wind control technique and rushed back to Taiping County.
"This old guy left happily. Could it be that he was really a good person?" Qin Fan couldn't help but think to himself as he looked at Lu Wenqiu's retreating figure.
Out of caution, Qin Fan used his spiritual sense to investigate and tracked Lu Wenqiu to the limit of one mile, but found nothing unusual.
title_en: Chapter 17: Get rid of harm to the people first and then make a fortune Chapter 18: Buy whatever is awesome in Wushanfang City’s big purchase
